## Session and user options: one default each

<!-- GENERATED by MACOS_resources/mmacos/src/gen_mex_wrappers.py --targets defaults
     from binding_overrides.OPTIONS; every quoted default is READ from the named
     source at generation time.  Do not edit: re-run the generator. -->

Every session or user option the bindings expose has ONE default, held by the engine (set at allocation when it is engine state); the CLI, mmacos and pymacos inherit it.  **A veneer never carries a default an api getter can supply** (Dave 2026-10-10).  *Status*: **inherits** -- the veneer reads the engine; **agrees** -- the veneer restates the engine's value and the api has no getter to inherit from; **fixed** -- a restatement removed 2026-10-16 (A.6); **Dave** -- a judgment call, routed with the measurement.  Gates: mmacos `tDefaults`, pymacos `tests/test_defaults.py` (same decks, same numbers).

| Option | Engine default | api get / set | CLI | mmacos | pymacos | Override | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Session modes: POLARIZATION, VECTOR/SCALAR, CENTROID, LNEG, CIR | `.FALSE.` (`macos_mod.F`): ifPol/ifVecDif3/ifCentroid/ifPGColor .FALSE., ifLNegOK .TRUE., at allocation (macos_mod_init); survive LOAD | `modes_get` / `pol_set`, `vecdif_set`, `modes_set` (CENTROID, LNEG; 2026-10-28) | POLARIZATION, VECTOR/SCALAR, CENTROID/CHIEFRAY, LNEG/NOLNEG, CIR/GIR; LOAD names the non-default ones | `macos.modes()`; `macos.modes('centroid', tf, 'lneg', tf)` sets; `load_rx` warns `mmacos:modesInForce` | `modes()`; `modes_set(centroid=, lneg=)`; `load` warns (RuntimeWarning) | `polarization(...)`, `modes('centroid', tf)` / `modes_set(...)`; CIR has no api setter (CLI only) | **inherits** |
| OPD reference (chief ray / aperture mean) | `.TRUE.` (`traceutil_mod.F`): session LOpdRefChief (chief), at allocation; per deck `UseChfRay4OPD= Y\|N`; per loaded deck `opd_ref_set` | `opd_ref_get` / `opd_ref_set` | OPDREF CHIEF\|MEAN (session); `UseChfRay4OPD=` (deck) | `''` (`dw_dx.m`): `opd()` / `opd_ref()` inherit; the dw_* harvests' `opd_ref`: the deck's own as loaded (was `'chief'`, re-applied after the reload: it overrode `UseChfRay4OPD= N` and left the session on chief) | `opd()` / `opd_ref()` inherit (no harvest veneer) | `opd_ref('mean'\|'chief')` for the loaded deck; a harvest's `opd_ref` | **fixed** |
| FEX / SXP axis (chief ray / beam centroid) | `.FALSE.` (`macos_mod.F`): session mode ifCentroid (.FALSE. = chief), at allocation | `modes_get` / `xp_fnd`, `sxp_fnd` | CENTROID / CHIEFRAY, then FEX / SXP | `[]` (`fex.m`): `fex(mode)`, `sxp(mode)`: empty = the session axis read through `modes_get` (was a fixed 1; `sxp` also refused 0) | `None` (`macos.py`): `fex(mode)`, `sxp(mode)`: None = the session axis (was a fixed 1) | `fex(0)` / `fex(1)` per call | **fixed** |
| SPOT centre (element vertex / chief ray) | `1` (`macos_init.inc`): spcOption (1 = element vertex), at allocation | `spc_option_get` / `spot_cmd` | SPCENTER ELT\|CHFRAY | `''` (`spot.m`): `spot(srf, at=)`: empty = the session centre (`spc_option_get`) | `None` (`macos.py`): `spot(srf, vpt_center=)`: None = the session centre | per call (`at='chief'` / `vpt_center=False`); `spot_cmd` restores the session option after the call | **inherits** |
| Obscuration option (OBS ALL / POSITIVE / NEGATIVE) | `1` (`macos_init.inc`): iObsOpt (1 = POSITIVE: unobscured rays), at allocation; survives LOAD since 2026-10-28 (named in the LOAD notice / `modes().in_force`) | `obs_opt_get` / `obs_set` | OBS | `obs()` queries (`obs_opt_get`), `obs(opt)` sets | `None` (`macos.py`): `obs_set()` queries (was: SET positive), `obs_set(opt)` sets | `obs('all'\|'negative')` / `obs_set(...)` | **inherits** |
| Far-field evanescent cut | `.FALSE.` (`dftsub.F`): dft_mod ifFFEvanCut (off), at allocation | `ffcut_get` / `ffcut_set` | (none: api only) | `ffcut()` queries, `ffcut(on)` sets | `ffcut()` queries, `ffcut(on)` sets | `ffcut(true)` | **inherits** |
| OPD / mask array orientation | no engine state: the raw array is [i = global X, j = global Y] | `opd_val`, `opd_mask_get` / -- | (OPD writes the raw array) | `raw` (`opd.m`): `opd(orient=)`, `opd_mask(orient=)` | `raw` (`macos.py`): `opd(orient=)`, `opd_mask(orient=)` | `orient='xy'` (the transpose) | **agrees** |
| Valid-pixel mask (opdValid) | opdValid from the last OPD trace (zero is NOT "no ray") | `opd_mask_get` / -- | (OPD) | `opd_mask()` | `opd_mask()` | -- | **inherits** |
| remove_ptt in the sensitivity harvests | no engine state | (no getter) / -- | -- | `false` (`dw_dsurf.m`): `dw_dsurf`, `dw_dsurf_multi` | (no harvest veneer; tests/sensitivities drivers) | `remove_ptt=true` | **agrees** |
| Model size | `256` (`macos_mod.F`): the CLI's start-up prompt: Return = this default; SMACOS with no size: 256 too (param_mod) | (no getter) / `init` | prompted at start-up; Return = 256 | `256` (`init.m`): `init(model_size)` default | `256` (`macos.py`): `init(model_size=)` default | `init(N)` | **agrees** |
| Polarization source state on POLARIZATION ON | Ex0/Ey0 = 0 (unset) until set; `pol_get` reads it | `pol_get` / `pol_set` | POLARIZATION prompts for Ex, Ey | `[1 0]` (`polarization.m`): `polarization('on', Ex=, Ey=)` Ex default | `(1.0, 0.0)` (`macos.py`): `polarization('on', Ex=, Ey=)` Ex default | `Ex=`, `Ey=` | **agrees** |
